attestations.text: CHU Kuei 朱珪 (T. 石君, H. 南厓, 盤陀居士), Feb. 18, 1731–1807, Jan 13, official and scholar, younger brother of Chu Yün [q. v.], was a native of Ta-hsing (Peking). In 1748, when only eighteen sui, he received his chin-shih degree.
